## Asset 1
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 full-screen menu backdrop for original educational kinetic crystal game ages 9–10.
Primary request: 16-bit pixel-art crystal cave with deep navy and indigo cavern walls, luminous cyan and magenta crystal clusters, and water reflecting the crystals.
Style: authentic crisp chunky pixel art, hard square pixel edges, restricted vibrant palettes, carefully designed shapes, no blurry digital painting.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape. Keep the LEFT 40 percent dark and uncluttered for later game menu UI; dramatic crystal formations concentrated on right and bottom framing. Broad calm dark cavern recess behind the left region.
Constraints: environment illustration only. No text, buttons, UI, characters, logos, watermark. Original game art.

## Asset 2
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 original pixel-art overworld game map background for Brazilian educational crystal adventure ages 9–10.
Primary request: elevated top-down/isometric 16-bit pixel landscape with four connected regions in quadrant arrangement. Northwest: indigo crystal cave mouth with cyan/magenta crystals. Northeast: lush Brazilian Atlantic forest. Southeast: winding blue river and green riverbanks. Southwest: high rocky mountain.
Composition: one cohesive wide landscape with neutral winding earth footpaths connecting the four regions, clearly legible terrain at game scale. Include some environmentally damaged patches, cut tree stumps, dry earth near healthy forest and clean green waterbanks to support restoration theme.
Style: crisp chunky hard pixel edges, rich yet limited palettes, charming polished 16-bit game art.
Constraints: no level nodes, markers, text, UI, frames, characters, Mario or other existing game assets, logos, watermark.

## Asset 3
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square game sprite atlas on GENUINE transparent background with preserved alpha.
Primary request: Exactly 9 isolated original 16-bit pixel gem sprites in an invisible 3-by-3 equal-square-cell atlas. Each gem centered at exact cell center; roomy transparent margins around each sprite, consistent scale filling about 55 percent of cell.
Row 1 left to right: white quartz prism; fiery orange opal teardrop; cyan aquamarine sphere.
Row 2 left to right: turquoise tourmaline oval with neon rings around it; green emerald hexagon; gold citrine pyramid.
Row 3 left to right: orange imperial topaz column; magenta rubellite oval; icy blue star-shaped diamond.
Style: crisp chunky hard square pixel edges; limited saturated palettes, bright highlights, dark outline. Clearly different shapes and colors.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside sprites. No painted checkerboard, no solid background, no text, no visible grid, no drop shadows or decorations outside sprites, no logo or watermark. Entire square image evenly divided into 9 implicit cells; no sprite crosses its cell.
## Asset 4 — ecology-atlas.png
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art ecology game sprite atlas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS (12 sprites), landscape 4:3 canvas.
Primary request: exactly 12 isolated sprites on genuine transparent RGBA background in an invisible regular grid of equal square cells. Every sprite centered at its exact cell center and wholly within its cell, generous empty transparent padding; sprite fills approximately 60 percent of cell.
Exact row-major order:
Top row, left to right: (1) glowing cave painting stone panel inspired by Brazilian rock art; (2) luminous green moss patch; (3) cluster of glowing cyan and magenta mushrooms; (4) leafy tropical Brazilian tree.
Middle row, left to right: (5) tropical green sapling; (6) brown cut tree stump; (7) blue river fish; (8) toxic litter represented by a discarded bottle with purple residue.
Bottom row, left to right: (9) wooden waterwheel; (10) dark smog puff; (11) stylized green-purple aurora ribbon; (12) golden tiny seed with green shoot.
Style: authentic 16-bit game sprites, crisp chunky hard square pixel edges, limited saturated palettes, strong readable silhouettes, dark outlines with luminous highlights; coherent navy, cyan, magenta, rich green palette, brown wood and gold seed.
Constraints: EXACTLY 4 columns and 3 rows, no variants or extra sprites, no visible cell borders, no text or numbers, no background scene, no painted checkerboard, no solid background. GENUINE transparent alpha outside sprites, preserve alpha in PNG. No shadows extending beyond sprites, no watermark.
